name: make
title: Makefile Targets
description: Every Makefile target under your project folders in one list. Enter runs it in a terminal or in the background, with variables typed in first.
author: pal

settings.label: Project folders
settings.description: Folders scanned two levels deep for a Makefile, makefile or GNUmakefile. ~ is expanded.

settings.label: Run in
settings.description: Where Run puts make. A terminal keeps its window open until you press Enter; background runs it unseen and toasts the exit status (the output opens in the panel when it failed; a run past 8 s is left to finish on its own). On Linux the terminal is $TERMINAL, else kitty, foot, alacritty, xterm.

store.tagline: Every Makefile target under your projects, Enter runs it
features: Every target of every Makefile in your project folders, one section per project
Each target's `## description` shown beside it
`enter` runs `make <target>` in a terminal in the project folder, left open so you can read the output
Or run it in the background: a notice with the exit status, the full output when it failed
The side pane shows the recipe; `cmd+l` opens the whole Makefile, `cmd+c` copies the command

screenshots.caption: Every target of the Makefiles under the configured folders, a section per project, its ## description under the name
The detail pane (cmd+I): the Makefile and the target on top, its description, then its recipe
Show Makefile (cmd+L): the whole file in the panel, the ## comments that describe the targets included
What a target can do: run it, copy the make command, open the project, show the Makefile

actions.title: Run
actions.description: make <target> in a terminal in the project folder, or in the background per the setting; the bar takes optional words after the target first (VERBOSE=1, -j4).
